title: Klebsiella phage KpTDp2 isolated from sewage water
description: Multidrug resistant klebsiella pneumiae presents a real threat for the global health. As an alternative to the antibiotic treatments, during this study, a new phage from sewage water was isolated, characterized and its genome was sequenced and annotated in order to learn more about this phage.
center: University Tunis El Manar, Faculty of Science of Tunis, Biochemistry and Biotechnology Laboratory
